name: classic-geode-miss
_comment: GEODE dead-round path: the capacity never moves, so the tap's start window (GEODE_START_MS) times out, the FULL animation wait (GEODE_DELAY_MS, classic min(120,max(15,left)) sleep slicing, progress-refreshing) runs to its deadline, the judge sees nothing and breaks with zero digs, and the round nudges W forward (LAND_PROBE_NUDGE_MS + PROBE_GAP_MS). The quit lands inside the post-nudge PROBE_GAP sleep — deliberately NOT inside a sensing wait: the native supervisor still runs its queued nudge action after a stop lands mid-wait, while the ScriptRunner halts between atoms, so a mid-wait quit would diverge on the post-stop tail (a stop-discipline difference, not a leg-semantics one). Companion to classic-geode; same vendoring rules.
_screen_comment: Whole-box capacity paint (see classic-shards): keyframes are 0/1 only.
